intro.text: A starved prisoner in the God King's dungeon, apparently the leader of a rebellion, held in a colourless cell meant for Awakeners because his Breath is so valuable.
A Pahn Kahl rebel leader, held and tortured in the God King's dungeon for the hoard of Breath he carries.

items.text: Vahr worked long hours in the dye fields around Hallandren for little but food, and spent at least ten years trying to rouse his fellow workers to revolt. Then he hit on asking them to give him their Breath, and its power, coming from people as rebellious as he was, hardened his resolve.
With it he tried to raise a Pahn Kahl army against Hallandren itself, funded by Hallandren's rival trading partners, and he soon became a hero to the workers of the outer flower plantations.
Rira, Ashu, Paxen and other Idrian crime lords paid to feed his army, though they disliked that he was not Idrian and cared mostly for their own wealth and power. Grable backed him as well.
Lemex and the Idrian royal family quietly supported him too, as King Dedelin hoped the uprising would turn Hallandren's attention away from Idris.
His fame among the dye workers caught the notice of the Court of Gods. The gods thought him a fool and no real threat, but still wanted him captured.

He is held beneath the God King's palace in a cell drained of all colour, gagged and hung from the ceiling by chains so he cannot Awaken anything. Unwilling to execute him before he hands over his Breath, his captors spend two weeks beating, burning and cutting him.

Vasher, who had gone looking for him, offers to end Vahr's life in exchange for his Breath, pointing out he cannot hold out much longer and promising his enemies will never get it. Vahr agrees and gives it up, and Vasher strangles him with an Awakened scarf.
He failed, but people did not forget his promises, which made them readier to listen when Vivenna's work in the city stirred up unrest.
The hundreds of Breaths he gave Vasher kept Vasher alive and let him perform complex Awakenings again.

appearance.text: Tan-skinned. Once a plump man, he is painfully thin after his imprisonment, covered in bruises, burns and cuts, with a haunted look in his eyes.

personality.text: Captivity has made him harder and colder, a change Vasher can at last relate to.
